end_date.description: The end date for the range of events to search, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

include_recurring.description: A flag to indicate whether to include recurring events in the search.

function.name: reschedule_event
function.description: Reschedule an event by assigning it a new date or time based on the provided ISO-8601 datetime string. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

new_datetime.description: The new date and time to which the event is being rescheduled, in ISO-8601 format (e.g., 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ').
